reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput: kaiba: move to swift-crypto 5.x and clamp AutoAction limit/sleep (no GitHub issue URL or number supplied)
reviewContext.userProblem: The owner requires every Swift package in the Riela dependency graph to require and build against apple/swift-crypto 5.x (>= 5.0.3) so Riela resolves a single 5.x version. Two AutoAction safety clamps from Riela f5a26c83 and cf34383d never reached kaiba: a negative retry limit becomes an unbounded SQLite LIMIT, and the heartbeat seconds-to-nanoseconds conversion can trap on overflow.
requiredOutcomes: Package.swift requires swift-crypto from: "5.0.3" and Package.resolved pins swift-crypto 5.x >= 5.0.3 via swift package update swift-crypto (K3).
Hashing/HMAC outputs and existing crypto tests are unchanged; any source edit is a minimal swift-crypto 5 compile fix (K3).
retryPendingAutoActionDispatches binds max(limit, 0); limit -1 and 0 return 0 and leave pending rows pending; authorization checks still run first (K15).
autoActionDispatchLeaseHeartbeatIntervalNanos is internal, caps seconds at Double(UInt64.max / 1_000_000_000) before multiplying, returns 0 for non-positive/NaN, 300_000_000_000 for 900 (K15).
Focused tests in Tests/AppCoreTests/AutoActionRecoveryTests.swift cover the limit and heartbeat clamps.
Patch version bump 0.1.18 -> 0.1.19 at VERSION, Sources/AppCore/Version.swift, web/src-tauri/Cargo.toml, web/src-tauri/Cargo.lock (kaiba-client), web/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, matching cf1254b.
swift build, full swift test, mise run lint and mise run check pass; one commit pushed to origin main; linux-amd64-build.yml conclusion recorded.
nonGoals: No GitHub releases, Homebrew formulas or casks.
No workaround for a dependency capping swift-crypto below 5; report a blocker with the exact constraint instead.
No behavior change to AutoAction dispatch beyond the two clamps; no other refactors.
No changes to .riela/, node_modules/, tmp/ui-preview-compat/, schema DDL or generated schema Swift.
constraints: Plans run in wave 1 with disjoint writePaths; no git write operations by workers; per-plan progress files under tmp/swift-crypto-5/<P#>/.
Every command is teed to tmp/swift-crypto-5/<P#>/logs/NN-name.log ending with exit=<code>; incomplete logs are not passes.
Swift files stay under 1000 lines (AutoActionTests.swift is ~991 lines, so new tests go in AutoActionRecoveryTests.swift).
Commit messages carry no AI attribution and no emojis.
Full gates (swift test, mise run lint, mise run check) run only in serial integration.
designDecisionsAndRationale: K3: CryptoKit on Apple platforms, swift-crypto only on Linux via .when(platforms: [.linux]); macOS builds never link Crypto, so the Linux compile is verified by a local container build when docker is available and by linux-amd64-build.yml after push.
K15: the limit is clamped to 0 rather than raised to 1 because LIMIT 0 is safe and a caller asking for zero rows should get zero; no early return so authorization behavior is unchanged.
K15: the heartbeat helper is made internal (like autoActionDispatchLeaseCutoff) so tests can call it directly; capping before multiplying keeps UInt64 conversion in range.
intentionalTradeoffs: The Linux compile against swift-crypto 5 may only be proven after the push through linux-amd64-build.yml when docker is unavailable locally.
P1 and P2 share .build; the SwiftPM lock serializes them, worst case is a rebuild; full serial swift test re-proves everything.
P2 asserts limit: 1 returns 1 as the positive-path check; a default-call assertion of the remaining pending count is optional (reviewer low finding).
supportedEdgeCases: swift-crypto resolution capped below 5 reported as blocked (cap)
docker unavailable logged as 'linux-local: unavailable (no docker)'
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Riela clamp-form parity when /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela is unreadable; K15 remains the contract.
Upgrading other dependencies (anydoc-swift pin stays at 0aa4756d0ce3f97cc94f1de9efe26879808097c8).

acceptanceCriteria: retryPendingAutoActionDispatches binds .int(Int64(max(limit, 0))). The authorization checks still run before the query, with no early return.

autoActionDispatchLeaseHeartbeatIntervalNanos is internal. It returns 0 for 0, negative, NaN and -infinity, and 300_000_000_000 for 900. It returns the finite cap UInt64(Double(UInt64.max / 1_000_000_000) * 1_000_000_000) without trapping for infinity, greatestFiniteMagnitude and 1e30.
The new limit test fails before the fix (red log) and passes after. limit -1 and 0 return 0 and leave the pending count unchanged. limit 1 returns 1.
swift test --filter AutoActionRecoveryTests and --filter 'AutoActionTests|AgentChatDispatchSecurityTests' exit 0 with 0 failures. swiftlint on both files exits 0. Both files stay under 1000 lines.
verification: swift test --filter AutoActionRecoveryTests (red before the fix, green after)

policies.editProtocol: See the impl-plans/active/swift-crypto-5.md Edit protocol. Read each file fresh and record pre and post sha256 hashes. Drift means stop with status: blocked (drift). Edit only your own writePaths. No git write operations, branches or worktrees.
policies.sharedBuildCache: .build is owned by P1 as an artifact root. P2 also builds into it through SwiftPM, whose lock serializes concurrent invocations. No plan runs mise run anydoc:native, build, test or check. The Linux container never mounts the repository root.
policies.protectedPaths: .riela/, node_modules/, tmp/ui-preview-compat/, design-docs/, schema/note-store.sqlite.sql, Sources/AppCore/NoteStoreSchemaDDL.generated.swift, any impl-plans/active/*-dispatch.json.
policies.evidencePolicy: Tee every command into tmp/swift-crypto-5/<P#>/logs/NN-name.log, ending with exit=<code>. Record the complete log path and the final exit status. An incomplete log is not a pass.
policies.integration: Run serially after acceptance: swift build, swift test (full), mise run lint, mise run check. Then make one commit without AI attribution, push to origin main, and watch linux-amd64-build.yml in the foreground and record its conclusion. No releases, formulas or casks.
